build.buildCommand: pwd && ls -la && npm i -g pnpm@10.19.0 && if [ "$SERVICE_TYPE" = 'frontend' ]; then pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && cd frontend && pnpm run build; else pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && cd backend && npx prisma generate && pnpm run build; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ "$SERVICE_TYPE" = 'frontend' ]; then npx serve -s frontend/dist -l $PORT; else node backend/dist/main; fi
